papers.title: Planning Patterns for Evidence-Grounded Research Agents
papers.abstract: This synthetic study compares linear and iterative planning patterns for research agents. It reports that explicit evidence checkpoints improve traceability in the demonstration setting, while additional tool calls increase latency.

papers.title: Citation Auditing in Automated Literature Reviews
papers.abstract: This synthetic paper describes structural checks for citation coverage in machine-generated literature reviews. Structural coverage detects missing citation markers but cannot establish whether a source semantically supports a claim.

papers.title: Multi-Perspective Question Generation for Literature Discovery
papers.abstract: This synthetic experiment organizes literature searches around theory, methods, empirical results, and limitations. The demonstration finds broader topical coverage than a single undifferentiated query, with lower precision for peripheral questions.

papers.title: Abstract-Only Evidence Extraction: Boundaries and Failure Modes
papers.abstract: This synthetic analysis catalogues failure modes in abstract-only evidence extraction. Missing sample details, selective reporting, and absent appendices limit the reliability of downstream synthesis.

papers.title: Reproducible State Machines for Long-Running Academic Agents
papers.abstract: This synthetic system report stores planning, retrieval, extraction, writing, and audit states as inspectable artifacts. Checkpointed stages support recovery after interruption and simplify evaluation of individual pipeline components.
